notes.title: v1.8.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
shamefully, during the last update i did not have steam support installed for ren'py, so achievements were not being tracked. this SHOULD BE fixed now... hopefully it recorded them properly for the people who completed the game in v1.8.0



i'm really sorry about this!!!! i'll be more careful going forward ;o;

notes.title: console release, and various other updates!
notes.notes:
lots of updates today!!! first of all, THE GAME IS NOW AVAILABLE ON CONSOLES!!!!!! that's playstation 4 and 5, xbox, and nintendo switch! (you can play it on switch 2 as well haha)



some of the translations were updated, including:

a brand new japanese translation

minor edits for german, italian, french, and i think spanish (latam)...? i should've written this down.



i worked with Serenity Forge to make all of this happen! we also released a new game today, a visual novel called Return to Ash. we made a steam bundle so people can buy it together with BAD END THEATER if they want to! it's a brand new story that will make you cry in a good way... i hope everyone likes it, wahhh!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445830/Return_to_Ash/"][/dynamiclink]

the last piece of news is...

MAIDEN AND OVERLORD PLUSHIES ARE RETURNING...! the campaign starts july 14th! tell your friends~ i'll probably post another update once the campaign gets started too ^^ i don't want anyone else to miss out on them!



thanks for playing BAD END THEATER!



-nami

notes.title: New Steam Release: her tears were my light
notes.notes:
hello! so... this is a late announcement. but i released one of my older games on steam!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2112520/ss_4fde4e63af251753331c49a7f57e7a7b8834d001.1920x1080.jpg?t=1665028954

if you enjoyed the "lesbians trapped in a time loop" aspect of BAD END THEATER, then i think you'll enjoy this one too :) it's a much shorter and simpler game, but it has just as much love in it.

for more info, check out the game page HERE!

i'm really sorry for not making this announcement sooner--i actually didn't realize steam allowed you to cross-promote your games like this. and then i was waiting for the chinese translation to be finished, because i know i have a large chinese audience... anyway, i'll be sure to put it on sale again soon, so i hope you'll wishlist if you're interested in playing!

thanks for reading <3

-nami

notes.title: Czech Translation + Japanese Update!
notes.notes:
BAD END THEATER has been translated to czech, thanks to David "Dejw136" Benáček!

this update also includes a japanese re-translation by Katsuhide and Sota! they went through the whole game and edited all the lines, so it should sound a lot more natural now! i hope japanese players will take the chance to replay the game with all the improvements ^^ thank you, Katsuhide and Sota!!

v1.5.0 updates:

added czech translation
updated japanese translation
spanish (es) and basque typo fixes
the scrolling text in the menus has been re-coded to not allow line breaks (a very minor issue that only appeared in certain languages)

thanks for playing BAD END THEATER!

-nami

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.notes:
hi, everyone! first of all, thanks so much for playing BAD END THEATER!! the response has been way bigger than expected--i'm so happy my game is making such an impact on people <3

i had to do a couple hotfixes within the first couple days of release, but there doesn't seem to have been any major bugs (thank goodness!). there was one bit of feedback i felt i had to address though, thus the balance patch!

**SPOILERS AHEAD!!**

v1.0.5 updates:

TRAGEDY now does 5 damage to start (instead of 1), decreasing with each party member you summon. wrong answers will increase TRAGEDY's damage by 1.
a shortcut for total reset has been added to the game menu (appears after you've gone through the resetting process at least once)
music gallery is no longer locked after total reset
minor art fixes
typo fixes for korean and chinese translations

thanks again for playing BAD END THEATER! i hope to add more languages in the next update :) stay tuned!

-nami
